```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```


Round a number:
```{r}
num <- 3.14159
rounded_num <- round(num)
print(rounded_num)
```

Argument order:
```{r}
print(rep(5,7))
print(rep(times = 7, x =5))
```
Character, numerical and logical variables
```{r}
char <- "A"
num <- 1
logi <- TRUE
print(paste(char,class(char)))
print(paste(num,class(char)))
print(paste(logi,class(char)))
```
Using variables of different types:
```{r}
cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"
treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_1 <- FALSE
num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123
num_cells_after_1 <- 1432
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543

```

Exploring the quirks of R
```{r}
print(TRUE + TRUE)
print(TRUE + FALSE)
print(5 + TRUE)

x <- 0 / 0
print(x)
print(is.na(x))
print(is.nan(x))

print(1/0)
print(-1/0)
```

Vectors
```{r}
cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"
treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE
num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123
num_cells_after_1 <- 1432
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543

col1 <- c(cell_ID_1,cell_ID_2)
col2 <- c(treated_1,treated_2)
col3 <- c(num_cells_before_1,num_cells_before_2)
col4 <- c(num_cells_after_1,num_cells_after_2)
```

Indexing
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
fourth <- all_my_pets[4]
print(fourth)

```

Vectorisation
```{r}
x <- c(2, -4, 6, -2)
abs(x)


```

Creating a data frame
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

cell_ID_1 <- "CX1"
cell_ID_2 <- "CX2"
treated_1 <- TRUE
treated_2 <- FALSE
num_cells_before_1 <- 5415
num_cells_before_2 <- 8123
num_cells_after_1 <- 1432
num_cells_after_2 <- 7543

col1 <- c(cell_ID_1,cell_ID_2)
col2 <- c(treated_1,treated_2)
col3 <- c(num_cells_before_1,num_cells_before_2)
col4 <- c(num_cells_after_1,num_cells_after_2)

table <- tibble(
  cell_id = col1,
  treated = col2,
  num_cells_before = col3,
  num_cells_after = col4
)

gt(table)
```
